scientific_discovery.title: Resolving the 99.8% Fringe Paradox
scientific_discovery.proof: While headline water shrank by -4.15 km², 99.8% of new inundation (4.68 km²) and 99.5% of recession (8.83 km²) was confined to the marginal DpRVI > 0.60 reed zone. The core thalweg (DpRVI < 0.15) drifted by only -0.62 km², matching the spatial-shift null noise spread [-0.67, +0.02] km².
